ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (UltimateStrike.cs:18-21) == cost 1 / ATTACK / UNCOMMON / ANY_ENEMY.

CanonicalTags.rationale: `new HashSet<CardTag> { CardTag.Strike }` (UltimateStrike.cs:14) == the tag set. Load-bearing: an Amalgamator run that combines its Strikes into this card must still count as holding a Strike for card/perfected_strike.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(14m, ValueProp.Move)` (UltimateStrike.cs:16) == `_damage = 14`, powered on both sides.

OnPlay.rationale: `DamageCmd.Attack(14).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)` (UltimateStrike.cs:26-28) == the sim's single `DamageCmd.deal(..., dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`. No follow-up effect and no guard on either side -- card/strike with bigger numbers.
